summary.headline: Geomancy, Aeromancy, and Chiromancy
summary.text: Discussion of geomancy, aeromancy, and chiromancy: geomancy relies on Saturn and the lord of the hour and the reason of number, aeromancy is dismissed as frivolous, and chiromancy is considered possibly part of physiognomy, deriving the soul’s habits from the body’s exterior form and stellar influence.
